description: This file contains functions related to configuration changes and restoration in the Raft consensus algorithm, specifically translating configuration states and applying changes to a tracker.

methods.name: toConfChangeSingle
methods.description: Converts a ConfState into slices of configuration change operations for outgoing and incoming configurations.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Executes a sequence of change operations on a Changer, updating its Config and Progress.

methods.name: Restore
methods.description: Restores a Raft configuration from a ConfState by applying a sequence of configuration changes to an empty Changer.
